The fields can be sorted either ASC or DESC. <br><br>	Scenario 1: When mulitple sort paramters needs to be requested. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to sort the results in the Ascending order of courtId and caseId, My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: sortParameterQuery=courtId,ASC&caseId,ASC <br><br>	Scenario 2: When you want to sort the response using the case parameters in the party search. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to sort the results in the Ascending order of caseOffice and descending order of caseId, My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: sortParameterQuery=courtCase.caseOffice,ASC&caseid,DESC|
|caseStatus|query|string \| null|false|Status of a case. 'closed' for a Terminated case, 'open' for Pending cases. If this parameter is not sent both cases that fall in open and closed will be queried.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|false|Page Number for a given Job ID or for the search your going to make.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|caseStatus|open|
|caseStatus|closed|

## PACER Case Locator Search API for All Courts.

<a id="opIdCriminalCourtsPacerCaseLocatorPartySearch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/pacerCaseLocator/partySearch/criminalCourts?pacerUserId=john_doe&pacerClientCode=john' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /pacerCaseLocator/partySearch/criminalCourts`

PACER Case Locator Party Search API for Criminal Courts.

<h3 id="pacer-case-locator-search-api-for-all-courts-9-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pacerUserId|query|string|true|User ID or User Name of the PACER Account used while signing in to PACER.|
|pacerClientCode|query|string|true|Client Code used while signing in to PACER account.|
|caseNumber|query|string \| null|false|If the court type is selected as All or if you need data for a specific case number format, then you need to use this option. Case numbers may be entered in each of the following formats: <br><br>	yy-nnnnn <br><br>	yy-tp-nnnnn <br><br>	yy tp nnnnn <br><br>	yytpnnnnn <br><br>	o:yy-nnnnn <br><br>	o:yy-tp-nnnnn <br><br>	o:yy tp nnnnn <br><br>	o:yytpnnnnn <br><br>where: <br><br>yy  case year (may be 2 or 4 digits) <br><br>nnnnn  case number (up to 5 digits) <br><br>tp  case type (up to 2 characters) <br><br>o  office where the case was filed (1 digit).|
|pacerCaseId|query|integer|false|Sequentially generated number that identifies the case in PACER system.|
|lastName|query|string \| null|false|The last name of a party to search. This can be person or non person entity.|
|firstName|query|string \| null|false|The first name of a party to search.|
|middleName|query|string \| null|false|The middle name of a party to search.|
|generation|query|string \| null|false|The name suffix (e.g., III, MD).|
|partyType|query|string \| null|false|The court-assigned party type for a party involved in a case. Party type codes are created and assigned by individual courts, and as such, their meanings can vary from court to court.|
|partyExactNameMatch|query|boolean|false|When set to true this field will search the party with an exact match of the name provided.|
|partyRoleArray|query|[string \| null]|false|The court-assigned role for a party to a case. Party role codes are created and assigned by individual courts, and as such, their meanings can vary from court to court.|
|caseTitle|query|string \| null|false|You can search using the case name even if you know one party. <br><br>	Examples: <br><br>	A search for case title john doe v will result in all cases with the case title John Doe v. <br><br>	A search for case title Acme, Inc. will result in all case titles starting with Acme, Inc.|
|caseOffice|query|integer|false|The divisional office in which the case was filed.|
|caseSequenceNumber|query|integer|false|The sequence number of a given case. Ex 12345|
|caseYear|query|integer|false|The two digits or four digits of the year in which the case was filed.|
|caseTypeArray|query|[string \| null]|false|Search can be narrowed down by passing caseTypes. Please use the <a href='https://docs.unicourt.com/pacer-glossary/appendix-a-case-types'>APPENDIX A: Case Types</a> mentioned in the API Documentation. <br><br>	Scenario: When mulitple case types needs to be requested. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to search only with the case type civil(cv) and criminal(cr), My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: caseTypeArray=cv&caseTypeArray=cr|
|courtRegionIdArray|query|[string \| null]|false|Search can be narrowed down by passing courtRegionId. Please use the <a href='https://docs.unicourt.com/pacer-glossary/appendix-b-court-regions'>APPENDIX B: Court Regions</a> mentioned in the API Documentation. <br><br>	Scenario: When mulitple court region ids needs to be requested. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to search in the court regions California Central (cac) and California Eastern (cae), My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: courtRegionIdArray=cac&courtRegionIdArray=cae|
|caseYearFrom|query|integer|false|Limit the results of the search to those cases from the year specified or later|
|caseYearTo|query|integer|false|Limit the results of the search to those cases from the year specified or earlier|
|caseFiledStartDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case filed start date on or after the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|caseFiledEndDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case filed end date on or before the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|caseTerminatedStartDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case terminated start date on or after the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|caseTerminatedEndDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case terminated end date on or before the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|sortParameterQuery|query|string \| null|false|The criteria based on which the search results are to be sorted. Please use the <a href='https://docs.unicourt.com/pacer-glossary/appendix-c-sort-parameter'>APPENDIX C: Sort Parameter - Sortable Party Parameters</a> mentioned in the API Documentation. The fields can be sorted either ASC or DESC. <br><br>	Scenario 1: When mulitple sort paramters needs to be requested. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to sort the results in the Ascending order of courtId and caseId, My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: sortParameterQuery=courtId,ASC&caseId,ASC <br><br>	Scenario 2: When you want to sort the response using the case parameters in the party search. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to sort the results in the Ascending order of caseOffice and descending order of caseId, My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: sortParameterQuery=courtCase.caseOffice,ASC&caseid,DESC|
|caseStatus|query|string \| null|false|Status of a case. 'closed' for a Terminated case, 'open' for Pending cases. If this parameter is not sent both cases that fall in open and closed will be queried.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|false|Page Number for a given Job ID or for the search your going to make.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|caseStatus|open|
|caseStatus|closed|

## PACER Case Locator Search API for All Courts.

<a id="opIdMultiDistrictCourtsPacerCaseLocatorPartySearch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/pacerCaseLocator/partySearch/multiDistrictCourts?pacerUserId=johndoe&pacerClientCode=john' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /pacerCaseLocator/partySearch/multiDistrictCourts`

PACER Case Locator Party Search API for MultiDistrict Courts.

<h3 id="pacer-case-locator-search-api-for-all-courts-10-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pacerUserId|query|string|true|User ID or User Name of the PACER Account used while signing in to PACER.|
|pacerClientCode|query|string|true|Client Code used while signing in to PACER account.|
|caseNumber|query|string \| null|false|If the court type is selected as All or if you need data for a specific case number format, then you need to use this option. Case numbers may be entered in each of the following formats: <br><br>	yy-nnnnn <br><br>	yy-tp-nnnnn <br><br>	yy tp nnnnn <br><br>	yytpnnnnn <br><br>	o:yy-nnnnn <br><br>	o:yy-tp-nnnnn <br><br>	o:yy tp nnnnn <br><br>	o:yytpnnnnn <br><br>where: <br><br>yy  case year (may be 2 or 4 digits) <br><br>nnnnn  case number (up to 5 digits) <br><br>tp  case type (up to 2 characters) <br><br>o  office where the case was filed (1 digit).|
|jpmlNumber|query|integer|false|Master JPML Case Number.|
|pacerCaseId|query|integer|false|Sequentially generated number that identifies the case in PACER system.|
|lastName|query|string \| null|false|The last name of a party to search. This can be person or non person entity.|
|firstName|query|string \| null|false|The first name of a party to search.|
|middleName|query|string \| null|false|The middle name of a party to search.|
|generation|query|string \| null|false|The name suffix (e.g., III, MD).|
|partyType|query|string \| null|false|The court-assigned party type for a party involved in a case. Party type codes are created and assigned by individual courts, and as such, their meanings can vary from court to court.|
|partyExactNameMatch|query|boolean|false|When set to true this field will search the party with an exact match of the name provided.|
|partyRoleArray|query|[string \| null]|false|The court-assigned role for a party to a case. Party role codes are created and assigned by individual courts, and as such, their meanings can vary from court to court.|
|caseTitle|query|string \| null|false|You can search using the case name even if you know one party. <br><br>	Examples: <br><br>	A search for case title john doe v will result in all cases with the case title John Doe v. <br><br>	A search for case title Acme, Inc. will result in all case titles starting with Acme, Inc.|
|caseOffice|query|integer|false|The divisional office in which the case was filed.|
|caseSequenceNumber|query|integer|false|The sequence number of a given case. Ex 12345|
|caseYear|query|integer|false|The two digits or four digits of the year in which the case was filed.|
|caseTypeArray|query|[string \| null]|false|Search can be narrowed down by passing caseTypes. Please use the <a href='https://docs.unicourt.com/pacer-glossary/appendix-a-case-types'>APPENDIX A: Case Types</a> mentioned in the API Documentation. <br><br>	Scenario: When mulitple case types needs to be requested. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to search only with the case type civil(cv) and criminal(cr), My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: caseTypeArray=cv&caseTypeArray=cr|
|courtRegionIdArray|query|[string \| null]|false|Search can be narrowed down by passing courtRegionId. Please use the <a href='https://docs.unicourt.com/pacer-glossary/appendix-b-court-regions'>APPENDIX B: Court Regions</a> mentioned in the API Documentation. <br><br>	Scenario: When mulitple court region ids needs to be requested. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to search in the court regions California Central (cac) and California Eastern (cae), My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: courtRegionIdArray=cac&courtRegionIdArray=cae|
|caseYearFrom|query|integer|false|Limit the results of the search to those cases from the year specified or later|
|caseYearTo|query|integer|false|Limit the results of the search to those cases from the year specified or earlier|
|caseFiledStartDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case filed start date on or after the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|caseFiledEndDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case filed end date on or before the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|caseTerminatedStartDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case terminated start date on or after the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|caseTerminatedEndDate|query|string(date-time) \| null|false|Narrowing the search by limiting the cases which matches the criteria for case terminated end date on or before the given date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+ZZ:zz, Ex: 2017-12-20T12:54:24+00:00|
|sortParameterQuery|query|string \| null|false|The criteria based on which the search results are to be sorted. Please use the <a href='https://docs.unicourt.com/pacer-glossary/appendix-c-sort-parameter'>APPENDIX C: Sort Parameter - Sortable Party Parameters</a> mentioned in the API Documentation. The fields can be sorted either ASC or DESC. <br><br>	Scenario 1: When mulitple sort paramters needs to be requested. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to sort the results in the Ascending order of courtId and caseId, My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: sortParameterQuery=courtId,ASC&caseId,ASC <br><br>	Scenario 2: When you want to sort the response using the case parameters in the party search. <br><br>	Imagine for a given case number 12-1234 I would like to sort the results in the Ascending order of caseOffice and descending order of caseId, My query in the request will look like the example mentioned below. <br><br>	Example: sortParameterQuery=courtCase.caseOffice,ASC&caseid,DESC|
|caseStatus|query|string \| null|false|Status of a case. 'closed' for a Terminated case, 'open' for Pending cases. If this parameter is not sent both cases that fall in open and closed will be queried.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|false|Page Number for a given Job ID or for the search your going to make.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|caseStatus|open|
|caseStatus|closed|

<h1 id="unicourt-enterprise-apis-court-standards-api">Court Standards API</h1>

## AreaOfLaw Object.

<a id="opIdgetAreasOfLaw"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/masterData/areaOfLaw \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /masterData/areaOfLaw`

Returns AreaOfLaw Object.

## Logical Operators
| Connector | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** |Find data containing all connected terms.|**google AND facebook**|
| **OR**  |Find data containing any connected term.| **order OR decision**|
| **NOT** |Exclude data.| **google NOT apple**.|
| **“[phrase]”** |Find an exact phrase.| **"Google Inc”** |
| **( … )** |Parenthesis may be used to group sets of terms of connectors.| **google (facebook OR apple)**.|

### All Filter Query parameters supported for this API can be found in below schema section. Schema --> AreaOfLawQueryObject


<h3 id="areaoflaw-object-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for.<br>The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters.<br>All options are documented above.</a><br>|
|pageNumber|query|integer|false|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>- maximum: 100<br>|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort field.|
|order|query|string|false|Sort order.|

|---|---|
|sort|name|
|order|asc|
|order|desc|

```json
  ]
```
```json
}
```

<h3 id="norm-attorney-details-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[NormAttorney](#schemanormattorney)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|[Exception](#schemaexception)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error|[Exception](#schemaexception)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Judges faced by the Attorney.

<a id="opIdgetNormJudgesAssociatedWithNormAttorney"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normAttorney/NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY/associatedNormJudges?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normAttorney/{normAttorneyId}/associatedNormJudges`

Returns a list of Judges faced by the Attorney.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"  AND  courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz", "CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get all judges associated with attorney with norm id NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and  case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]
<br><br>


<h3 id="judges-faced-by-the-attorney-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normAttorneyId|path|string|true|Norm ID of Attorney. <br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

## Law Firms the attorney has worked for.

<a id="opIdgetNormLawFirmsAssociatedWithNormAttorney"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normAttorney/NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY/associatedNormLawFirms?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normAttorney/{normAttorneyId}/associatedNormLawFirms`

Returns a list of Law Firms the norm Attorney has worked for.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"  AND  courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz", "CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get all LawFirms associated with attorney with norm id NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and  case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]
<br><br>


<h3 id="law-firms-the-attorney-has-worked-for-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normAttorneyId|path|string|true|Norm ID of Attorney. <br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

## Parties Represented By the Attorney.

<a id="opIdgetNormPartiesAssociatedWithNormAttorney"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normAttorney/NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY/associatedNormParties?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normAttorney/{normAttorneyId}/associatedNormParties`

Returns a list of Parties the Attorney has represented.
<br><br>
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"  AND  courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz", "CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object.. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed   |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get all parties associated with attorney with norm id NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and  case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]
<br><br>


<h3 id="parties-represented-by-the-attorney-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normAttorneyId|path|string|true|Norm ID of Attorney. <br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

## Parties Represented by the Law Firm.

<a id="opIdgetNormPartiesAssociatedWithNormLawFirm"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normLawFirm/NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT/associatedNormParties?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normLawFirm/{normLawFirmId}/associatedNormParties`

Returns list of Parties represented by the Law Firm.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get all parties associated with LawFirm with norm id NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and  case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]
<br><br>

|normLawFirmId|path|string|true|Norm  ID of the Law Firm.<br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

## Attorneys Associated with the Judge.

<a id="opIdgetNormAttorneysAssociatedWithNormJudge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normJudge/NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq/associatedNormAttorneys?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normJudge/{normJudgeId}/associatedNormAttorneys`

Returns a list of attorneys associated with a judge.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtLocationId IN ("COLOOY8WTHDBLL0eWv","COLOItKA5pBVovpQSZ")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get all attorneys associated with judge with norm id NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]
<br><br>


<h3 id="attorneys-associated-with-the-judge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normJudgeId|path|string|true|Norm  ID of the Judge.<br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[AssociatedNormAttorneyResponse](#schemaassociatednormattorneyresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|[Exception](#schemaexception)|

## Law Firms Associated With the Judge.

<a id="opIdgetNormLawFirmsAssociatedWithNormJudge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normJudge/NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq/associatedNormLawFirms?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normJudge/{normJudgeId}/associatedNormLawFirms`

Returns a list of Law Firms a Judge has heard.

## Parties Associated with the Judge.

<a id="opIdgetNormPartiesAssociatedWithNormJudge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normJudge/NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq/associatedNormParties?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normJudge/{normJudgeId}/associatedNormParties`

Returns a list of Parties A Judge has seen.

## Attorneys that represented the Party.

<a id="opIdgetNormAttorneysAssociatedWithNormParty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normParty/NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT/associatedNormAttorneys?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normParty/{normPartyId}/associatedNormAttorneys`

Returns a list of  Attorneys the Party has been represented by.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTqrgr5iFOXfIBmk")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get all attorneys associated with Party with norm id NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and  case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]
<br><br>


<h3 id="attorneys-that-represented-the-party-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normPartyId|path|string|true|Norm ID of the Party.<br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[AssociatedNormAttorneyResponse](#schemaassociatednormattorneyresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|[Exception](#schemaexception)|
|404|Not Found|Not Found|[Exception](#schemaexception)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error|[Exception](#schemaexception)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

## Judges Faced By the Party.

<a id="opIdgetNormJudgesAssociatedWithNormParty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normParty/NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT/associatedNormJudges?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normParty/{normPartyId}/associatedNormJudges`

Returns a list of Judges the party has faced.
<br><br>
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTqrgr5iFOXfIBmk")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get all judges associated with Party with norm id NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and  case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]
<br><br>


<h3 id="judges-faced-by-the-party-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normPartyId|path|string|true|Norm ID of the Party.<br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

## Law Firms that represented the Party.

<a id="opIdgetNormLawFirmsAssociatedWithNormParty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normParty/NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT/associatedNormLawFirms?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normParty/{normPartyId}/associatedNormLawFirms`

Returns a list of Law Firms the Party has been represented by.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTqrgr5iFOXfIBmk")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |

## Example Query
Query to get all lawfirms associated with Party with norm id NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and  case filed date between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="law-firms-that-represented-the-party-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normPartyId|path|string|true|Norm ID of the Party.<br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

## Case Count Analytics by Court Location.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByCourtLocation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByCourtLocation?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByCourtLocation`

Get Case Count Analytics grouped by Court Location.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **normAttorneyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular norm Attorney Object. | **normAttorneyId:"NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY"** |
| **normPartyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Object. | **normPartyId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normLawFirmId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Norm LawFirm Object. | **normLawFirmId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normJudgeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Judge Object. | **normJudgeId:"NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get case count grouped by court location  of all cases with court id CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz and filed between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="case-count-analytics-by-court-location-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|

## Case Count Analytics by Court System.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByCourtSystem"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByCourtSystem?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByCourtSystem`

Get Case Count Analytics grouped by Court System.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **normAttorneyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular norm Attorney Object. | **normAttorneyId:"NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY"** |
| **normPartyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Object. | **normPartyId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normLawFirmId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Norm LawFirm Object. | **normLawFirmId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normJudgeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Judge Object. | **normJudgeId:"NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get case count grouped by court system of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and filed between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="case-count-analytics-by-court-system-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|

## Case Count Analytics by Attorney.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByNormAttorney"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByNormAttorney?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByNormAttorney`

Returns Case Analytics by Attorney.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **normAttorneyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular norm Attorney Object. | **normAttorneyId:"NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY"** |
| **normPartyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Object. | **normPartyId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normLawFirmId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Norm LawFirm Object. | **normLawFirmId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normJudgeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Judge Object. | **normJudgeId:"NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get case count grouped by norm attorney of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and filed between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="case-count-analytics-by-attorney-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|

## Case Count Analytics by Judge.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByNormJudge"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByNormJudge?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByNormJudge`

Returns Case Analytics by Judge.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **normAttorneyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular norm Attorney Object. | **normAttorneyId:"NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY"** |
| **normPartyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Object. | **normPartyId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normLawFirmId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Norm LawFirm Object. | **normLawFirmId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normJudgeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Judge Object. | **normJudgeId:"NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get case count grouped by norm judge of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and filed between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="case-count-analytics-by-judge-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|

## Case Count Analytics by Norm Law Firm.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByNormLawFirm"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByNormLawFirm?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByNormLawFirm`

Returns Case Analytics by Norm Law Firm.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **normAttorneyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular norm Attorney Object. | **normAttorneyId:"NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY"** |
| **normLawFirmId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Norm LawFirm Object. | **normLawFirmId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normPartyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Object. | **normPartyId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normJudgeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Judge Object. | **normJudgeId:"NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get case count grouped by norm lawfirm  of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and filed between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="case-count-analytics-by-norm-law-firm-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|

## Case Count Analytics by Party.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByNormParty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByNormParty?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByNormParty`

Returns Case Analytics by Party.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |

## Case Count Analytics by Party Role.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByPartyRole"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByPartyRole?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByPartyRole`

Returns Case Analytics by Party Type.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **normPartyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Object. | **normPartyId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get case count grouped by party role of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and filed between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="case-count-analytics-by-party-role-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|

## Case Count Analytics by Party Role Group.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByPartyRoleGroup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/caseCountAnalyticsByPartyRoleGroup?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /caseCountAnalyticsByPartyRoleGroup`

Returns Case Analytics by Party Type Group.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **normPartyId** | Multiple Ids Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Party Object. | **normPartyId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |

## Case Count Analytics by Opposing Norm Law Firm.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByOpposingNormLawFirmForANormLawFirm"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normLawFirm/NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT/caseCountAnalyticsByOpposingNormLawFirm?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normLawFirm/{normLawFirmId}/caseCountAnalyticsByOpposingNormLawFirm`

Returns Case Analytics by Norm Law Firm.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
