## Case Count Analytics by Opposing Norm Party.

<a id="opIdgetCaseCountAnalyticsByOpposingNormPartyForANormParty"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/normParty/NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT/caseCountAnalyticsByOpposingNormParty?pageNumber=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /normParty/{normPartyId}/caseCountAnalyticsByOpposingNormParty`

Returns Case Analytics by Opposing Norm Party.
## Terms and Connectors
| Connector | Schema   | Description  | Example |
| ------| ------| ------|------|
| **AND** ||Find analytics containing all connected terms. The word AND does not have to be capitalized.|**courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz" AND courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"**|
| **IN()** || Allows you to specify multiple values, for a limit of up to 10.| **courtId IN ("CORTKQiA4LJuv54tEj","CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz")**|
| **courtId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Object. | **courtId:"CORTV4vCEaKrhystBz"** |
| **courtSystemId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court System Object. | **courtSystemId:"COSYACHBdMewtaG5DY"** |
| **courtTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Type Object. | **courtTypeId:"COTPm8jjc2PAydpFhq"** |
| **courtLocationId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Court Location Object. | **courtLocationId:"COLO6b82CkRqS846hx"** |
| **caseTypeId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Object. | **caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c"** |
| **caseTypeGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Type Group Object. | **caseTypeGroupId:"CTYG8gZ6hPRKhhYi4Y"** |
| **areaOfLawId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Area Of Law Object. | **areaOfLawId:"AOFL2UxEWfVmTPMyqf"** |
| **caseClassId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Case Class Category Object. | **caseClassId:"CSCLNjbKTN7Yfo2wdb"** |
| **partyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Object. | **partyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **partyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Party Type Group Object. | **partyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleId:"PTYRiP8nMgPxBsPc5i"** |
| **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId** | Multiple Ids Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Attorney Party Type Group Object. | **attorneyPartyRoleGroupId:"PTYGBnjxbx6tKNfVEP"** |
| **normAttorneyId** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular norm Attorney Object. | **normAttorneyId:"NATYfwmXwRHS279WPY"** |
| **normLawFirmId** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a particular Norm LawFirm Object. | **normLawFirmId:"NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT"** |
| **normJudgeId** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics for a particular Judge Object. | **normJudgeId:"NJUDT7jCZyFNeLGpRq"** |
| **caseFiledDate** | Single Allowed  |Find Analytics within a particular date range. | **caseFiledDate:[2018-05-08T00:00:00+00:00TO2019-05-08T00:00:00+00:00]** |
| **JurisdictionGeo** | Multiple filters Allowed |Find Analytics within a particular Jurisdiction Geo. | **(JurisdictionGeo:(state:"California"))** |
| **confidenceScore** | Single Allowed |Find Analytics for a given ConfidenceScore  | **confidenceScore>=0.5** |
| **bestMatch** | Single Allowed |True if the normEntity has the highest Confidence Score of all possible normEntities | **bestMatch:true** |
<br>
## Example Query
Query to get case count grouped by norm party with norm id NORGrPmQyLdx9NGHcT of all cases with case type id CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c and filed between Jan 1st, 2017 to Nov 30th,2021<br>
q=caseTypeId:"CTYPATMYyaJekdgj2c" AND caseFiledDate:[2017-01-01T00:00:00+00:00TO2021-11-30T00:00:00+00:00]


<h3 id="case-count-analytics-by-opposing-norm-party-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|q|query|string|false|The URL encoded query you are searching for. The query can be as simple as a keyword, but supports many additional options and filters. All options are documented above.|
|pageNumber|query|integer|true|Page number.<br>- minimum: 1<br>|
|normPartyId|path|string|true|Norm ID of the Party.<br>  - minimum: 18<br>  - maximum: 18<br>|

<h1 id="unicourt-enterprise-apis-callback-api">Callback API</h1>

## Get list of callback types with count for a requested Date.

<a id="opIdgetCallbacks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/callbacks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /callbacks`

Get list of callback types with count for a requested Date.

<h3 id="get-list-of-callback-types-with-count-for-a-requested-date-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|date|query|string(date-time)|false|Date for which fetch the callback type list. By default, the date will be set to current date.|
|status|query|string|false|Status of the callbacks. Default status will fetch all callbacks.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|IN_PROGRESS|
|status|COMPLETE|
|status|FAILURE|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "caseDocumentOrderCallbacks": {
    "count": 7,
    "link": "https://enterpriseapi.unicourt.com/caseDocumentOrder/callbacks?&date=2022-03-08T00:00:00+00:00"
  },
  "caseExportCallbacks": {
    "count": 6,
    "link": "https://enterpriseapi.unicourt.com/caseExport/callbacks?&date=2022-03-08T00:00:00+00:00"
  },
  "object": "CallbackListResponse"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": "UN400",
  "details": "Invalid request. Please check the `date`.",
  "message": "INVALID_INPUT",
  "object": "Exception"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": "UN500",
  "details": "Something went wrong. Please retry again later.",
  "message": "INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR",
  "object": "Exception"
}
```

<h3 id="get-list-of-callback-types-with-count-for-a-requested-date-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|OK|[CallbackListResponse](#schemacallbacklistresponse)|
|400|Bad Request|Bad Request|[Exception](#schemaexception)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Internal Server Error|[Exception](#schemaexception)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
bearerAuth
</aside>

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|admittedDate|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|The admittedDate is the date when an attorney was admitted to the bar of a given state.|
|barNumber|string \| null|true|none|none|
|barSourceData|[BarSourceData](#schemabarsourcedata)|true|none|none|
|barSourceType|string|true|none|none|
|contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|true|none|Contact object data schema.|
|firstFetchDate|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|inactivationDate|string(date-time) \| null|true|none|none|
|lastFetchDate|string(date-time)|true|none|none|
|lastFetchDateWithUpdates|string(date-time)|true|none|Last Fetch Date of the Attorney Update.|
|object|string|true|none|none|
|stateCode|string|true|none|none|
|status|string|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|Active|
|status|Inactive|
|status|Not Classified|
|status|Unknown|

|downloadAPI|string \| null|true|none|Link to either view the document if it is downloaded and already present in the UniCourt CrowdSourced Library.|
|estimatedOrderDuration|string|true|none|Estimated duration of a Order.|
|firstFetchDate|string|true|none|Is the date when the document was first fetched from the court site.|
|inLibrary|boolean|true|none|Determines if the document is present in the UniCourt Library or not.|
|isPreviewAvailable|boolean|true|none|Determines if a preview is available for the case document.|
|name|string \| null|true|none|Document name.|
|object|string|true|none|Name of the object|
|pages|integer \| null|true|none|Total number of pages in the document.|
|parentDocumentId|string \| null|true|none|Document ID which is the parent document for the current document. This will be null if the current document is a parent document.|
|previewDocument|[PreviewDocument](#schemapreviewdocument)|true|none|none|
|price|number \| null|true|none|Price of the document.|
|sortOrder|integer \| null|true|none|Order of documents how it is being stored in UniCourt.|
|sourceDataStatus|string \| null|true|none|The status of source data of document. If the value of sourceDataStatus is SOURCE_DEPRECATED then it means that the Document has been migrated from old court site to a new court site and the data being shown in the API response is from a old court site. If the sourceDataStatus is NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE_IN_COURT then it means that a particular case is invalid in the court site.|

|estimatedOrderDuration|withinMinutes|
|estimatedOrderDuration|withinHours|
|estimatedOrderDuration|withinDays|
|estimatedOrderDuration|withinWeeks|
|sourceDataStatus|NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE_IN_COURT|
|sourceDataStatus|SOURCE_DEPRECATED|
|sourceDataStatus|SEALED|
|sourceDataStatus|null|

<h2 id="tocS_CaseStats">CaseStats</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacasestats"></a>
<a id="schema_CaseStats"></a>
<a id="tocScasestats"></a>
<a id="tocscasestats"></a>

```json
{
  "allCaseDocumentCount": 379,
  "attorneyCount": 232,
  "caseDocumentInLibraryCount": 13,
  "docketEntryCount": 8503,
  "freeCaseDocumentCount": 254,
  "hearingCount": 2,
  "judgeCount": 1,
  "object": "CaseStats",
  "paidCaseDocumentCount": 125,
  "partyCount": 860,
  "relatedCaseCount": 1
}
```

Count of each entitiy of a case is mentioned here so that you can calculate the number of requests needs to be done to obtain each entity results completely.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allCaseDocumentCount|integer|true|none|Count which includes the freeCaseDocumentCount and paidCaseDocumentCount.|
|attorneyCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of attornies available in the case being requested for.|
|caseDocumentInLibraryCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of documents that are available in the UniCourt CrowdSourced Library for the case being requested for.|
|docketEntryCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of docket entries available in the case being requested for.|
|freeCaseDocumentCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of free documents available in the case being requested for.|
|hearingCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of hearings available in the case being requested for.|
|judgeCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of judges available in the case being requested for.|
|object|string|true|none|Name of the object|
|paidCaseDocumentCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of paid documents available in the case being requested for.|
|partyCount|integer|true|none|Count of number of parties available in the case being requested for.|
|relatedCaseCount|integer|true|none|Count of related cases that are available in the case being requested.|

<h2 id="tocS_CaseUpdatePacerOptions">CaseUpdatePacerOptions</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacaseupdatepaceroptions"></a>
<a id="schema_CaseUpdatePacerOptions"></a>

<a id="tocscaseupdatepaceroptions"></a>

```json
{
  "additionalPageArray": [
    {
      "fetchIfOlderThanDays": 30,
      "page": "associatedCases"
    },
    {
      "fetchIfOlderThanDays": 15,
      "page": "caseSummary"
    },
    {
      "fetchIfOlderThanDays": 15,
      "page": "listOfCreditors"
    }
  ],
  "fetchParticipantsIfOlderThanDays": 30,
  "pacerClientCode": "Test UniCourt API",
  "pacerUserId": "URKYwer3tyh5r56gq2",
  "refreshType": "fetchNewDocketEntries"
}
```

Applicable for PACER cases.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additionalPageArray|[object]|false|none|Currently this option is only applicable for Federal PACER cases. The default behavior of the Case Update is to fetch the Docket Report from PACER which includes the parties and attorneys too.<br><br>However if you need to fetch information for other pages in PACER you will need to specify it here.<br>- associatedCases:<br>> This will fetch the Associated Cases page in PACER if available. This page consists of related cases especially applicable for Multi-District Litigation cases and Member Cases. Including this option will internally link all related cases in our system. Data from this page will be available via the Related Cases API.<br>- caseSummary:<br>> This will fetch the Case Summary page in PACER if available. This page consists of additional case info which is not present in the Docket Report page. Data from this page will be structured and available as response in the Case API’s ```additional_info``` field.<br>- listOfCreditors:<br>> This page will fetch the “List Of Creditors” page for PACER Bankruptcy cases of case type "bk". Note that this page cannot be extracted for Bankruptcy cases of case type "ap" (Adversary Proceedings). This page consists of the Creditor information like the name and address of the Creditors. Data from this page will be structured and available as response in the Case API.<br>|
|fetchParticipantsIfOlderThanDays|integer|false|none|**Currently this option is only applicable for Federal PACER cases. You can limit how often parties and attorneys for a PACER case are fetched to reduce your PACER fees. If you are tracking cases daily or hourly you could easily end up with a large PACER bill.**<br><br>**Use Case: Cases are typically updated to check for new docket entry filings. However every update to PACER case costs money. Participants for a case change less often than docket entry filings. So fetching participants for every update might result in unnecessary PACER costs; especially on cases which have a lot of parties and attorneys. So instead of getting charged the minimum cost of $0.10 for an update which might have had few docket entries, you could end up spending $3 for every update because there were a lot of parties for that case that were also fetched.**<br><br>**With this option you can choose when to fetch parties for case based on when was it last fetched.**<br>You can limit how often this participants are fetched in a PACER case to keep your PACER costs under control.<br><br>Min days is 0 and Max days is 100.<br><br>Example:<br>1.  Specifying a value of 0 ensures that participants are fetched from PACER for this case update irrespective of when the participants were last fetched.<br>2.  Specifying a value of 30 ensures that participants are fetched from PACER for this case update only if the last fetch was older than 30 days.<br>|
|pacerClientCode|string \| null|false|none|PACER Client Code. This is mandatory if your setting in PACER website is set to True for required client code.|
|pacerUserId|string|true|none|**Your PACER credentials username. This is mandatory when a PACER Case is being requested in the API. For Non PACER cases this is not mandatory. Suppose your request consists of Non PACER and PACER Cases then this needs to be passed becuase you are requesting a PACER case too.**|
|refreshType|string \| null|false|none|This flag determines whether to pull only new or pull all the docket entries for a PACER case being requested.<br><br>Only one of the two values is allowed:<br>-   fetchNewDocketEntries:<br>    >   Updates the PACER case with only new docket entries that have been added after the previous update of the case being requested.<br>-   fetchAllDocketEntries:<br>    >   Updates the PACER case by re-parsing all dockets from #1 till latest docket entry available.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|refreshType|fetchNewDocketEntries|
|refreshType|fetchAllDocketEntries|

PACER District Courts - Here the primary document is one which is attached to the docket number. Because in district for a primary document it can have many attachments associatated to it.
